title: OCAD U Climbing
description: In my role as a merchandise designer for the OCAD U Climbing club, I created a custom shirt sponsored by Ozzy’s Burgers that captures the local climbing community through a map-style illustration. The design connects three key landmarks—Ozzy’s Burger shop, OCAD University, and Basecamp Climbing Gym—by recreating their physical structures into a unified visual narrative. To maintain the identity of each location, I reimagined the iconic architecture of OCAD U and Basecamp by translating their specific symbols and building styles into custom illustrations, blending branding with environmental storytelling.
